title: PageGroupDescriptor
description: Describes a menu group/folder that can contain pages and sub-groups.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: create page groups when several pages belong to the same feature area. Pages reference groups by `group`. Nested groups reference parent groups by `parent`. Use stable kebab-case names and concise user-facing titles.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Unique URL-safe identifier for the group. Prefer kebab-case, for example 'crm' or 'content-studio'.

app.description: Name of the low-code app that owns this group. Omit for the default app. Must match an apps[].name.

title.description: Display title for the menu group.

icon.description: FontAwesome icon class, for example 'fa-solid fa-folder' or 'fa-solid fa-calendar-days'.

order.description: Sort order within the parent level (lower values appear first)

parent.description: Name of the parent group for nesting. Must match another pageGroups[].name. Omit for root-level groups.

extendsLowerLayer.description: When true, this descriptor overrides selected fields of a page group with the same name defined in a lower model layer; title becomes optional.
